name: Your Company
niche: Joinery workshop: custom solid-wood and live-edge slab furniture

listing.description: A site for a joinery workshop or a maker of solid-wood and slab furniture. A tree cross-section whose growth rings draw themselves on the first screen, products as lines in a workbook, wood species as grain samples and the work stages along a tape measure.

seo.title: Your Company — custom solid-wood and slab furniture, Tashkent
seo.description: A joinery workshop in Yunusabad: live-edge dining tables, beds, wardrobes and kitchen islands in oak, walnut and elm. No chipboard, oil and wax finish, from 3 weeks.
seo.answer: Your Company is a joinery workshop at 210 Bogishamol St in Tashkent. We make chipboard-free furniture in solid oak, walnut, ash and local elm: a live-edge slab table from 9,500,000 UZS, an oak bed from 12,000,000 UZS, a coffee table from 3,800,000 UZS. From 3 weeks, oil and wax finish, and you can choose the board for your table at the workshop. Open Mon–Sat, 9:00–18:00.

sections.title: Solid-wood furniture that will outlive us
sections.subtitle: We make custom tables, beds, wardrobes and slabs in oak, walnut and local elm. Each piece is led by one maker — from the board to the last coat of oil.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: Five joiners and a nine-metre workbench
sections.text: We join wood with tenons and wedges, not screws, dry boards to 8% moisture and never hide them under lacquer. That is why a table can be sanded back in twenty years and look new again.

sections.label: Pieces
sections.title: What we make by hand
sections.intro: “From” prices are for the base size. We give the exact figure after the sketch — it depends on the board you choose.

items.title: Live-edge dining table
items.text: One-piece slab with a live edge, steel or solid legs. 4–6 weeks.

items.title: Solid-wood bed
items.text: A frame joined on tenons with no metal, a headboard of solid slats. 4 weeks.

items.title: Wardrobe with hinged doors
items.text: Panelled doors, shelves and a rail to your layout. 5–6 weeks.

items.title: Coffee table
items.text: Round or rectangular, with a lower shelf. 3 weeks.

items.title: Bookcase
items.text: Wall to wall, each shelf holds 40 kg. 4 weeks.

items.title: Kitchen island
items.text: Solid-wood worktop, drawers on concealed runners. 6 weeks.

items.title: Sketch and measuring
items.text: We talk about how the piece will be used and draw a sketch with dimensions.

items.title: Choosing the board
items.text: You visit the workshop and pick your own slab or boards.

items.title: Cutting and drying
items.text: Boards dry to 8% moisture before any work starts.

items.title: Joinery and sanding
items.text: Mortise-and-tenon joints, sanding up to 240 grit.

items.title: Oil and delivery
items.text: Three coats of hard-wax oil, then we deliver and install.

items.quote: We picked the slab ourselves and saw it at every stage. The table gathers the whole family every Friday.
items.author: Aziz

items.quote: A bed without a single screw — and nothing creaks. You can tell it was made by someone who loves wood.
items.author: Shahnoza

items.quote: Three years later we asked for the same table for a second flat — they found a board of the same shade.
items.author: Rustam

items.q: How long does a slab table take?
items.a: Four to six weeks, depending on size and whether the board needs further drying. The date goes into the contract.

items.q: Can I choose the board myself?
items.a: Yes — it is our favourite part. Come to the workshop: there are always 30–40 slabs of different species in stock.
Three coats of hard-wax oil. It shrugs off water and hot mugs, and you can touch up a scratch at home.

items.q: Do you work from other people’s drawings?
items.a: Yes, we work with designers and architects on their projects.
Five years on the joinery and a free refinish after the first year.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come and choose your board
sections.text: Send an idea or a photo you like — we will reply with a sketch and a price. You can visit the workshop during opening hours without booking.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Furniture catalogue
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.
